30c8dbdb.name: Life sciences and medicine
30c8dbdb.line: Biology and evolution textbooks alongside epidemiology, disease and health care; LC QH and RA dominate.

f1d7f096.name: Mathematics and statistics
f1d7f096.line: Linear algebra, analysis, calculus, probability and Bayesian statistics; the largest pile, almost all LC QA.

9eac45ba.name: Computing and artificial intelligence
9eac45ba.line: Programming, data structures, machine learning and neural networks, mostly practical textbooks.

ac0ca2d4.name: Philosophy, mind and religion
ac0ca2d4.line: Epistemology, philosophy of mind, ethics, complexity and religion, from Aristotle to Chalmers.

25be64d8.name: History, politics and physics
25be64d8.line: A mixture: world and war history, political science, race in America, physics and history of science.

208b9b5.name: Technology, engineering and forecasting
208b9b5.line: Technological forecasting and futures, operations research, safety engineering and electronics; LC T and TK.

a3c314ea.name: Psychology, logic and reasoning
a3c314ea.line: Cognitive psychology, judgment and decision making, critical thinking and formal logic; LC BF and BC.

47ee5a44.name: Economics and society
47ee5a44.line: Econometrics, microeconomics, game theory and social choice, alongside sociology, gender and crime.

423e836b.name: Business, finance and risk
423e836b.line: Management, investing and trading, insurance, and risk management from projects to disasters.

e7f91225.name: Anthropology and human culture
e7f91225.line: Cultural and forensic anthropology: how societies and human remains are studied, from Lévi-Strauss to Harris.

91d638d.name: Mental illness and psychiatry
91d638d.line: Psychiatric disorders, trauma and therapy, including critics of psychiatry such as Szasz and Whitaker.

c47a2643.name: Epidemics and infectious disease
c47a2643.line: Plagues, pandemics and outbreak histories, mostly popular accounts of communicable disease.

5814d3f1.name: Physiology, fitness and sleep
5814d3f1.line: Anatomy and physiology textbooks with exercise science, sleep and health-risk assessment.

a7638482.name: Health care and policy
a7638482.line: Health systems, medical policy and inequities in care: public aspects of medicine, not clinical science.

9391e0c2.name: Epidemiological methods
9391e0c2.line: Study design and statistics for epidemiology: case-control studies, observational methods, biometry.

369d8e7f.name: General biology textbooks
369d8e7f.line: Introductory life-science surveys and broad biology, with some ecology and philosophy of biology.

b3653fff.name: Evolution and natural selection
b3653fff.line: Evolutionary biology from Darwin onwards: textbooks and popular evidence-for-evolution books.

2db91536.name: Cell and molecular biology
2db91536.line: Molecular biology of cells and genes, biochemistry and some bioinformatics.

760b746c.name: Linear algebra
760b746c.line: Linear algebra and matrix textbooks, from solved-problem books to applied courses; several in French and German.

1f15bc2e.name: Systems and control theory
1f15bc2e.line: General systems thinking, control and optimal control, and the mathematics of complex systems.

27ae6b8e.name: Information and coding theory
27ae6b8e.line: Shannon-style information theory, error-correcting codes and the mathematical side of cryptography.

6ac04a9.name: Calculus and general mathematics
6ac04a9.line: Calculus courses and broad mathematics texts, plus some symbolic logic and geometry.

fde00c88.name: Probability and stochastic processes
fde00c88.line: Probability and statistics courses, random processes and regression: the bridge from theory to practice.

8648ea4e.name: Bayesian inference and decision theory
8648ea4e.line: Bayesian data analysis and statistical decision theory, from Lindley and Winkler to Gelman.

e18c1a54.name: Real and complex analysis
e18c1a54.line: Rigorous analysis texts on real variables, functions and measure, from Rudin to Lang.

ccb600ea.name: Mathematical statistics textbooks
ccb600ea.line: Introductory and mathematical statistics courses, many in French, Portuguese or German editions.

45fa32f1.name: Game theory
45fa32f1.line: Mathematical game theory from Luce and Raiffa to algorithmic game theory, in several languages.

56464eba.name: Artificial intelligence surveys
56464eba.line: General AI textbooks and books on AI's future and social impact, from Winston to Suleyman.

86d31999.name: Machine learning
86d31999.line: Machine learning textbooks and primers, from Michalski's 1983 collection to deep-learning introductions.

1064fe64.name: Programming languages
1064fe64.line: Python, C, C++ and Java programming books, mostly hands-on introductions.

3ed5a1ab.name: Neural networks
3ed5a1ab.line: Artificial neural networks, fuzzy systems and artificial life, with some neurobiology.

f801e20a.name: Knowledge representation and retrieval
f801e20a.line: Information retrieval, ontologies, databases and data mining: how machines store and find knowledge.

530fb902.name: Software engineering
530fb902.line: Software design, architecture and development practice: Brooks, Knuth, Beck and Evans.

d2d9a5f1.name: Cryptography and computer security
d2d9a5f1.line: Encryption, network security and access control, from Schneier's Applied Cryptography to exam guides.

329650c5.name: Data processing and discrete maths
329650c5.line: Discrete mathematics, statistical computing in R and SAS, and general computing courses.

44e8ae35.name: Algorithms and data structures
44e8ae35.line: Data structures and algorithm design, mostly textbooks tied to C, C++, Java or Python.

7618f434.name: Language, classics and communication
7618f434.line: A mixture: Greek and Latin classics, linguistics and semantics (Chomsky) and communication theory.

94c5fc2e.name: Complexity and scientific method
94c5fc2e.line: Popular and philosophical books on complexity and how science works, from Mitchell to Strevens.

b0f464fd.name: Chaos and complex systems
b0f464fd.line: Chaos, self-organisation and general system theory: how simple rules give complex behaviour.

5e4dfd3c.name: Epistemology
5e4dfd3c.line: Theories of knowledge: Popper, Pojman, Feldman, plus Indian and Objectivist epistemology.

dd21c357.name: Philosophy of science and metaphysics
dd21c357.line: History and philosophy of the natural and social sciences, from Bacon and Kant to Wilson.

a8061b.name: Religion, reason and atheism
a8061b.line: Religion-versus-reason debates, comparative religion and magic: Paine, Frazer, Dawkins, Plantinga.

f3d2fcf2.name: Philosophy of mind
f3d2fcf2.line: Consciousness and the mind-body problem: textbooks, handbooks and Chalmers; the largest pile here.

9143a544.name: Ethics and how to live
9143a544.line: Moral philosophy and life advice side by side: Stoics, Moore, Beauvoir and modern self-help.

2c39d01e.name: Christian theology and judgment
2c39d01e.line: Christian doctrine, the Bible and the last judgment, mostly devotional, with Kierkegaard and Plantinga.

1d2a76ec.name: Civilizations and secret codes
1d2a76ec.line: A mixture: histories of Western and world civilization, codes and ciphers, and forecasts of the future.

a2600188.name: World history
a2600188.line: World and modern history surveys and textbooks, from Palmer and Hobsbawm to Strayer.

6397d23d.name: Wartime codebreaking and intelligence
6397d23d.line: Second World War history centred on Enigma, Ultra and the secret intelligence services.

344f6169.name: Political science and theory
344f6169.line: Political analysis and theory from Locke to Dahl and Lasswell, including international relations.

b026f69c.name: Government, democracy and policy
b026f69c.line: American government, public policy-making and democracy, plus histories of political violence.

918e4db.name: Race in America
918e4db.line: African American history, thought and memoir: Du Bois, Baldwin, Coates, Kendi.

a25f8c6a.name: Physics, quantum and relativity
a25f8c6a.line: Physics textbooks and popular physics, quantum theory and its philosophy, from Feynman to Rovelli.

820bfbeb.name: Chemistry and history of science
820bfbeb.line: Chemistry textbooks with histories of science, astronomy and scientists.

2b4763c9.name: Geography, climate and environment
2b4763c9.line: Physical geography, climate change and food, with some environmental anthropology.

568bc82b.name: Safety and risk assessment
568bc82b.line: Engineering risk assessment and process safety: accident analysis, hazard control, system safety.

718b3cdb.name: Operations and production management
718b3cdb.line: Operations management textbooks for manufacturing and production: Heizer, Stevenson, Nahmias.

505f34ea.name: Operations research
505f34ea.line: Operations research and mathematical programming: optimisation textbooks from Hillier to Winston.

a452aaa8.name: Technological forecasting and futures
a452aaa8.line: Forecasting technology and society: diffusion of innovations, futures studies and techno-optimism.

58537f46.name: Information and systems engineering
58537f46.line: Information systems, soft systems methodology and information theory: Shannon, Forrester, Checkland.

2bb3a447.name: Decision analysis and management science
2bb3a447.line: Spreadsheet modelling, decision analysis and quantitative methods for decision makers.

98e23e5b.name: Digital logic design
98e23e5b.line: Digital circuits and logic design for computer engineering: Mano, Roth, Ciletti.

656fb0a.name: Signals and telecommunications
656fb0a.line: Signal processing, communication systems and their security, including Shannon's collected papers.

1f7caf33.name: Engineering probability and statistics
1f7caf33.line: Probability and statistics written for engineers and scientists, plus engineering mathematics.

a31d67c4.name: Logic and fallacies
a31d67c4.line: Introductory logic and argumentation textbooks, and books on spotting faulty reasoning.

2d96acf5.name: Judgment, Kant and puzzles
2d96acf5.line: A small mixture: Kant's Critique of Judgement, Kahneman on heuristics, logic puzzles and mind games.

387a061f.name: Judgment and decision making
387a061f.line: The psychology of choice: Kahneman, Plous, Hammond, plus popular how-we-decide books.

efe1ef35.name: Critical thinking
efe1ef35.line: Critical-thinking and reasoning courses, with rhetoric and argument; mostly textbooks.

6cf02029.name: Developmental psychology
6cf02029.line: Human development across the lifespan and moral stages, with a scattering of occult and prophecy books.

3fbe707.name: Success and self-help
3fbe707.line: Self-help on success, influence and relationships: Carnegie, Gladwell, Holiday.

a5407383.name: Learning, teaching and testing
a5407383.line: Educational psychology, thinking-skills workbooks and psychometric tests.

d8533f1c.name: Cognition and theory of mind
d8533f1c.line: Cognitive science of mind and knowledge: theory of mind, consciousness, Piaget.

fb75950a.name: Cognitive psychology
fb75950a.line: Cognitive psychology textbooks (Sternberg, Anderson, Eysenck) and popular cognitive science.

20a80f96.name: Econometrics
20a80f96.line: Econometrics textbooks from Koutsoyiannis to Wooldridge, with some Bayesian econometrics.

e51823f7.name: Game theory in economics
e51823f7.line: Economic game theory, mechanism design and strategy: von Neumann, Gibbons, Dixit, Roth.

b9507aab.name: Microeconomics
b9507aab.line: Microeconomics textbooks at every level, many in French, Dutch or German editions.

9d6c05a8.name: Sex, gender and relationships
9d6c05a8.line: Sexuality, gender, feminism and dating, mostly popular books; all in LC HQ.

cc1886be.name: Sociology
cc1886be.line: General sociology textbooks and classics of sociological thought, plus popular social psychology.

873951a0.name: Social and public choice
873951a0.line: Social choice, welfare economics and public choice: Arrow, Sen, Buchanan, Elster.

8b2ad823.name: Crime and criminology
8b2ad823.line: True crime, prisons, addiction and abuse; almost all LC HV.

fdb987c9.name: Public policy and social problems
fdb987c9.line: Policy-process textbooks, urban planning and social conditions, from Policy Paradox to Putnam.

a47e5840.name: Economic history and development
a47e5840.line: Economic history, development and forecasts of the economy, from Sowell and Rodney to Dalio.

f3a38f52.name: Management science
f3a38f52.line: Quantitative approaches to management: operations research for business, from Beer to Anderson.

4d5023d5.name: Stock trading and technical analysis
4d5023d5.line: Trading manuals, chart patterns and market forecasting: candlesticks, Elliott waves, stock picking.

25bbab5c.name: Insurance and risk
25bbab5c.line: Risk management and insurance textbooks, including aviation and liability insurance.

6b5df1d6.name: Business statistics and decisions
6b5df1d6.line: Business statistics and quantitative decision methods for managers, up to decision analysis.

e7a664f5.name: Financial management and risk
e7a664f5.line: Corporate finance, banking and quantitative models of financial risk.

e4f20991.name: Risk and project management
e4f20991.line: Enterprise and project risk management, credit and derivatives, including Hubbard and Flyvbjerg.

1201269f.name: Marketing, strategy and success
1201269f.line: Marketing, communication, business ethics and success literature: Dalio, Collins, Handley.

f77d88cd.name: Organizations and leadership
f77d88cd.line: Organization theory, leadership and managerial economics: Simon, Cyert and March, Morgan.

4c3afbd3.name: Disasters and catastrophic risk
4c3afbd3.line: Disaster management, natural hazards and global catastrophic risk, from Coppola to Bostrom and Smil.
